title: Private 2 Day Wilderness Adventure in British Columbia
includes: Private guided adventure for your group
Essential camping equipment and tent setup
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the beauty of British Columbia on a thrilling two-day wilderness adventure tailored just for your private group. Travel in a comfortable 4WD vehicle with an experienced guide who will lead you through scenic trails and seasonal activities. Enjoy delicious meals and refreshments included in this exclusive getaway. Each trip is customized based on current weather and trail conditions, ensuring a unique experience every time. Perfect for small groups of 2 to 7, this trip guarantees privacy and personalized attention throughout your journey.

Two-day private wilderness adventure for your group
Guided 4WD tours through stunning landscapes
All Meals and refreshments included during the trip
Experience tailored to current conditions for a unique adventure
